Sources and confidence

Evidence has a scope. A primary specification is different from a measurement.

Read the confidence label

Manufacturer specifications describe published capabilities. Our calculations show their formulas. Independent tests require an identified setup. A qualitative demand question is not search volume or representative user research. Unknown values remain unknown.
